category_feedback.specific_evidence: recovery_moves are generic and non-branching: 'Use time-benchmarks chart.', 'Drill with stopwatch.', 'Practice estimation before timing.' — none branches by what the diagnostic told you about the child, and no named research is cited in expanded_walkthrough.
category_feedback.required_fix: Rewrite expanded_walkthrough.recovery_moves to BRANCH by diagnostic: (a) if child says brushing = 2 seconds because they think 'seconds = anything fast', physically time them brushing and graph the gap (~118s); (b) if child cannot order events by duration at all, drop back to a 3-card sort (blink/song/sleep) before re-attempting magnitude; (c) if child knows order but not unit names, drill the 'blink/snap = SECOND, song = MINUTE, school day = HOUR' anchor chant. Cite research e.g. Friedman (1986) on children's time-magnitude estimation OR Ontario Math Curriculum 2020 Grade 2 E2.4 progression notes.
